subject: High School Building OPM Request for Services
overview: The committee approved the formal Request for Services to hire an Owner's Project Manager and expanded the selection subcommittee membership. Chair Graham also reported that the MSBA certified the high school's future enrollment at 1,395 students.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the September 18 full committee and subcommittee meetings.

items.title: MSBA Phase 1 Update
items.summary: Chair Graham reported that the MSBA certified an enrollment projection of 1,395 students and is expected to move the project into Phase 2 on February 26.

items.title: OPM Request for Services Review
items.summary: Approved the Request for Services (RFS) for an Owner's Project Manager, which includes an estimated project cost range of $200 million to $600 million. The committee amended the document to include WELL certification goals and refined the 100-point evaluation scale for candidate selection.

items.title: OPM Selection Committee Expansion
items.summary: Voted to expand the selection subcommittee by appointing Libby Brown and Dr. Suzanne Galussi as voting members and Paul Ruseau as a non-voting member.
